listing.name: (KTZ) TrueWeaponStats v1.2
listing.aiSummary: Displays calculated weapon stats in the refit screen and tooltips with a toggle for vanilla values.

description: Shows live combat statistics for mounted weapons, including built-ins and unique hulls. It uses runtime bytecode inspection to support multiple languages without configuration. Holding ALT toggles between modified stats and clean vanilla aesthetics.
